requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: At the time your application is submitted, and at the time AAIP assesses your application, you must work in an eligible occupation in Alberta.
requirements.label: Must be working in an eligible occupation in Alberta when applying and when assessed
requirements.section: Alberta Opportunity Stream — Eligible applicants

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: At the time your application is submitted, and at the time AAIP assesses your application, you must have a valid work permit – not status maintained during processing (formerly implied status) or restoration status.
requirements.label: Valid work permit of an eligible type (LMIA-based, certain LMIA-exempt, PGWP from an Alberta public institution, certain open permits); maintained or restoration status not accepted
requirements.section: Alberta Opportunity Stream — Eligible applicants

requirements.stream: AAIP (job offer & employer requirements, all streams)
requirements.subject: employer
requirements.label: The Alberta employer must have been in continuous and active operation in Alberta for a minimum of 2 complete fiscal years (the year used for tax or accounting purposes) prior to application submission
requirements.section: Job offer and employer requirements — Employer requirements

requirements.stream: AAIP (job offer & employer requirements, all streams)
requirements.subject: employer
requirements.label: The Alberta employer must have a minimum total gross annual revenue of $400,000 for the most recent fiscal year (the year used for tax or accounting purposes)
requirements.section: Job offer and employer requirements — Employer requirements

requirements.stream: AAIP (job offer & employer requirements, all streams)
requirements.subject: employer
requirements.label: Employment of a minimum of 3 full-time (or full-time equivalent) employees in Alberta (independent contractors do not count; two part-time employees may count as one full-time equivalent at an average of 30+ hours/week combined). If an employer cannot meet the revenue and staff minimums, it may still qualify but is capped on the number of nominees it can support based on years of operation (2 years → 1 nominee, 3 years → 2 nominees, +1 per additional year); Indigenous, municipal, provincial, Government of Canada and Government of Alberta employers are exempt from the revenue and staff minimums
requirements.section: Job offer and employer requirements — Employer requirements

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you must have an active Express Entry profile in the federal Express Entry pool
requirements.label: Active federal Express Entry profile required

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you meet the criteria of at least one of the federal immigration programs managed by Express Entry
requirements.label: Must qualify for CEC, FSW or FST

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you must have a minimum Comprehensive Ranking System score of 300
requirements.label: Minimum CRS score of 300

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: your primary occupation in your federal Express Entry profile must be included as part of a specific Express Entry stream pathway, or is identified as an occupation connected to a provincial economic, sector or occupational priority
requirements.label: Primary occupation must be in a stream pathway or a provincial priority occupation
requirements.section: Alberta Express Entry Stream — Minimum assessment requirements

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you and your Alberta employer must meet all the requirements outlined on Alberta Job Offer and Employment Requirements, if you are invited based on having an Alberta job offer
requirements.label: Alberta job offer and employer requirements apply if invited on a job offer
requirements.section: Alberta Express Entry Stream — Minimum assessment requirements

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you must intend to and be able to live and work permanently in Alberta and have stated an interest in immigrating permanently to Alberta

requirements.stream: AAIP Alberta Express Entry Stream — Accelerated Tech Pathway
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you must be working full-time in Alberta under an employment contract or have a bona fide job offer signed by you and your employer that: meets job offer and current employment contract requirements identified on the Alberta job offer requirements page , and: is in an occupation on the list of eligible Accelerated Tech Pathway occupations is for an Alberta employer whose primary business activities belong to the Alberta tech industry
requirements.label: Full-time Alberta job or job offer in an eligible tech occupation with an Alberta tech-industry employer
requirements.section: Alberta Express Entry Stream — Accelerated Tech Pathway requirements

requirements.stream: AAIP Alberta Express Entry Stream — Accelerated Tech Pathway
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: your primary occupation in your Express Entry profile must be the same occupation as your current Alberta employment or job offer
requirements.label: Express Entry primary occupation must match the Alberta job
requirements.section: Alberta Express Entry Stream — Accelerated Tech Pathway requirements

requirements.stream: AAIP Alberta Express Entry Stream — Priority Sectors
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: your primary occupation in your Express Entry profile must be an eligible construction, agriculture or aviation occupation
requirements.label: Primary occupation must be an eligible construction, agriculture or aviation occupation
requirements.section: Alberta Express Entry Stream — Priority sectors

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: All candidates must have an Endorsement of Candidate letter from their Designated Community. Endorsement of Candidate letter is only valid for one year from the date of issuance.
requirements.label: Endorsement of Candidate letter from the Designated Community (valid one year)
requirements.section: Rural Renewal Stream — Requirements

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you must have a full-time job offer or employment contract from an Alberta employer to work in an eligible occupation within an established business operation in your Designated Community
requirements.label: Full-time job offer in an eligible occupation within the Designated Community
requirements.section: Rural Renewal Stream — Requirements

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you must have a minimum of 12 months full-time work experience in an eligible occupation within the last 18 months prior to your application
requirements.label: 12 months of full-time work experience in an eligible occupation (last 18 months)
requirements.section: Rural Renewal Stream — Requirements

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Post-Graduation Work Permit holders who have completed a 2-year post-secondary education program at an IRCC designated learning institution in their Designated Community are not required to meet the 12 months of work experience criterion
requirements.label: PGWP holders with a 2-year program from a DLI in the Designated Community are exempt from the experience requirement
requirements.section: Rural Renewal Stream — Requirements

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you must have completed a minimum of high school education equivalent to the Canadian education standard
requirements.label: Minimum high school education equivalent to the Canadian standard
requirements.section: Rural Renewal Stream — Requirements

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you must demonstrate that you have sufficient funds to support yourself and your family members to settle in your designated community if: you are not residing in Canada, or you are currently in Canada but are not working
requirements.label: Settlement funds required if outside Canada or in Canada but not working
requirements.section: Rural Renewal Stream — Requirements

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You must have the required licensing, registration or certification to work in your current occupation in Alberta or occupation in your Alberta job offer
requirements.label: Required licensing, registration or certification for the occupation
